spec.description: Shows AWS Application load balancer metrics from Cloudwatch
ELB Connections metrics
spec.title: Connections

spec.description: The total number of bytes processed by the load balancer over IPv4 and IPv6. This count includes traffic to and from clients and Lambda functions, and traffic from an Identity Provider (IdP) if user authentication is enabled.
spec.title: Processed bytes

spec.description: The time elapsed, in seconds, after the request leaves the load balancer until a response from the target is received
spec.title: Target Response Time

spec.description: The number of targets that are considered healthy.
spec.title: Healthy targets

spec.description: The number of HTTP 5XX server error codes that originate from the load balancer. This count does not include any response codes generated by the targets.
spec.title: ELB HTTP Response 5XX (Count)

spec.description: The number of targets that are considered unhealthy.
spec.title: UnHealthy targets

spec.description: The number of load balancer capacity units (LCU) used by your load balancer.
spec.title: Consumed LCUs

spec.description: ELB Request metrics
spec.title: ELB RPS

spec.description:
The average request count per target, in a target group.

This count uses the total number of requests received by the target group, divided by the number of healthy targets in the target group. If there are no healthy targets in the target group, it is divided by the total number of registered targets.
spec.title: Target Request (Count)

spec.description: The number of HTTP 4XX response code returned from the targets
spec.title: Target HTTP 4XX (Count)

spec.description: The number of HTTP 3XX response code returned from the targets
spec.title: Target HTTP 3XX (Count)

spec.description:
The number of HTTP 4XX client error codes that originate from the load balancer. This count does not include response codes generated by targets.

Client errors are generated when requests are malformed or incomplete. These requests were not received by the target, other than in the case where the load balancer returns an HTTP 460 error code. This count does not include any response codes generated by the targets.
spec.title: ELB HTTP 4XX (Count)

spec.description: The number of HTTP 3XX redirection codes that originate from the load balancer. This count does not include response codes generated by targets.
spec.title: ELB HTTP 3XX (Count)

spec.description: ELB Request metrics
spec.title: ELB Request (Count)

spec.description: The number of HTTP 502 error codes that originate from the load balancer.
spec.title: ELB 502 Errors (Count)

spec.description: The number of HTTP 503 error codes that originate from the load balancer.
spec.title: ELB 503 Errors (Count)

spec.description: The number of HTTP 2XX response code returned from the targets
spec.title: Target HTTP 2XX (Count)

spec.description: Target RPS
spec.title: Target RPS

spec.description: The number of HTTP 5XX response code returned from the targets
spec.title: Target HTTP 5XX (Count)
